body.label: Body (bust outfit)
body.note: Torso + arms with clothing; used for bust-style avatars. Mutually exclusive with pose.

pose.label: Pose (full body)
pose.note: Full-body figure incl. legs; replaces body for full-body avatars. Sub-kinds: standing, sitting (incl. wheelchair, bike).

head.label: Head & hair
head.note: Hair / hijab / turban / hats. Face, facial hair and accessories are anchored relative to this atom.

face.label: Face expression
face.note: Eyes, nose, mouth. Placed at head + faceOffset.

facial-hair.label: Facial hair
facial-hair.note: Optional beard / moustache. Placed at head + facialHairOffset.

accessories.label: Accessories
accessories.note: Glasses, sunglasses, eyepatch. Placed at head + accessoriesOffset.

composition.description: Translate each atom by these offsets inside one SVG canvas, bottom → top: pose|body, head, face, facial-hair, accessories. Offsets for face/facial-hair/accessories are relative to the head origin.

recolour.note: Mono atoms expose a paintable background path (skin/cloth) and an ink path; colour variants use hard-coded hues listed in accentColours.
